capabilities: Marks risky phrases with colored underlines while typing
Explains each mark with the legal article and a rewrite tip
Lists all risky phrases in a sidebar panel
Applies custom terms, allowlists and per-folder rules
extras: Word lists and interface are in Chinese; notes over 300,000 characters are skipped; only tested on desktop; manual install until it is listed in the community directory.
motivation: The author's agency repeats this compliance judgment across client projects and wanted the criteria written down.
problem: Chinese marketing copy can carry banned superlatives, health claims or income promises, and Obsidian gives no in-editor way to catch them before publishing.
summary: Offline checker that marks risky Chinese advertising phrases in notes and shows the legal article and a rewrite suggestion.
